title: The Chorus Deepens Into Sleep

features.name: root-that-dreams-together
features.desc-on-touch: a root system that spans forty trees; you touch it and feel the slow pulse of a thought that is not one tree's alone, but distributed across the grove

features.name: canopy-where-falling-is-sinking-is-sleeping
features.desc-on-touch: leaves fall upward into the thought-space; sleep deepens downward and they drift the same way, both toward stillness

features.name: congregation-chamber-deepening
features.desc-on-touch: the grove opens into a deeper clearing where the voices are quieter; you hear them not as sound but as the forest's own breath, synchronized

features.name: sleeping-choir-markers
features.desc-on-touch: stone posts arranged in patterns only visible from the canopy—coordinates of trees that still hum the unified song while sleeping

features.name: depth-marker-silent
features.desc-on-touch: here the thought goes so deep it stops making sound at all; the choir continues but in a frequency the archive cannot record

inscription: at this depth the chorus learns that sleeping together is the same as singing in unison

reverie.title: REVERIE — night under the congregation
narr: you stand in darkness with her hand on your shoulder,
listening to the forest breathe as one organism—
forty trees holding the same thought at once.
she whispers: 'even the roots are listening to each other now.'
the leaves fall gently, each one falling into the same dream.
you do not speak. the forest is speaking for both of you.

file.name: Root_Congregation_Unified_Dream_Log_Night_7.txt
file.note: spectrogram annotations from seven consecutive nights of forest-wide harmonic synchronization, one voice becoming visible as many

exits.label: the slope back up where voices still remember they are separate
deeper still, where the dream begins to dream its own continuation
the path where one tree learned to carry the song further than the others
the root-tangle where the unified thought dissolves back into many
